sources_checked.citation: Emerson, Control Valve Diagnostics
sources_checked.supports: Combines sensor readings and diagnostic representations to assess valve-assembly condition.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe this complete evidence bundle or establish that it isolates root cause across all valve assemblies.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Multiple signals can improve context but do not ensure causal isolation; available sensors and evidence quality differ by product.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Define evidence-to-fault mappings and validation data for the actual device; preserve alternative causes and confirmation steps.

reviews.statement: Diagnostic result에는 confidence, data-quality flag와 missing·invalid data 처리를 포함한다.

sources_checked.citation: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0
sources_checked.supports: Calls for context-appropriate measurement and documentation of AI-system trustworthiness/risk.
sources_checked.gap: Does not require a confidence score or specific missing/invalid-data behavior for conventional positioner diagnostics.

reviews.unresolved_reason: These are good diagnostic-system design practices but not universal output fields or vendor capabilities.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Identify which diagnostics provide calibrated confidence/quality values and specify handling for missing or invalid signals.

reviews.statement: False positive와 false negative를 줄이기 위해 operating context와 maintenance confirmation을 사용한다.

sources_checked.citation: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0
sources_checked.supports: Requires context-aware evaluation and ongoing monitoring of AI-system risks.
sources_checked.gap: Does not validate this particular valve-diagnostic procedure or guarantee that context and maintenance confirmation reduce both error types.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Error rates depend on labeled outcomes, thresholds and operating distribution; maintenance confirmation can help ground truth but is not always available or independent.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Use a validated dataset, defined fault labels and context-stratified confusion metrics for the installed diagnostic application.

reviews.statement: Anomaly detection은 이상 징후를 찾는 단계이고 physical inspection과 test는 root cause를 확인하는 단계이다.

sources_checked.citation: Emerson, Control Valve Diagnostics
sources_checked.supports: Describes diagnostic indicators as useful for identifying assembly elements that may require maintenance.
sources_checked.gap: Does not define a universal detect/confirm workflow or require physical inspection for every diagnostic finding.

reviews.unresolved_reason: An alert is not automatically proof of a unique cause, but confirmation may use several methods, not only physical inspection/test.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Define evidence thresholds and approved confirmation methods by diagnostic and consequence; avoid equating anomaly with fault diagnosis.

reviews.statement: Maintenance workflow는 detect→verify→diagnose→prioritize→plan→repair→as-left 순서로 구성한다.

sources_checked.citation: Emerson, Control Valve Diagnostics
sources_checked.supports: Provides diagnostic information and recommended actions to identify components that may need maintenance.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe this exact mandatory sequence or include all governance/repair steps for every maintenance program.

reviews.unresolved_reason: This is a workflow model whose sequence and gates depend on reliability program, risk, work-management system and operating constraints.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Classify as a maintenance-process proposal and compare it with the site's approved work-management workflow.

reviews.statement: Time-based, condition-based와 predictive maintenance를 trigger, data requirement, cost와 risk 측면에서 비교한다.

sources_checked.citation: NIST, Predictive Maintenance research and manufacturing context
sources_checked.supports: Treats predictive maintenance as a data/model-supported maintenance approach in manufacturing contexts.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe this exact comparison framework or a universal cost/risk ranking against time- or condition-based maintenance.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The comparison dimensions are reasonable but outcomes depend on failure modes, consequence, data and maintenance economics.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Use a defined maintenance policy and asset-specific lifecycle data; do not infer one method is superior universally.

reviews.statement: Predictive maintenance는 degradation trend와 actionable lead time을 제시하지만 exact failure date를 보장하지 않는다.

sources_checked.citation: Emerson, Control Valve Diagnostics
sources_checked.supports: Describes diagnostics for condition monitoring and maintenance decision support.
sources_checked.gap: Does not promise a degradation trend or actionable lead time for every fault; the anchor generalizes predictive-maintenance performance.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The non-guarantee of an exact failure date is sound, but actionable lead time is data/model/failure-mode dependent and cannot be assumed.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Define the prognostic target, prediction horizon, uncertainty and validated lead-time performance for a specific failure mode.

reviews.statement: Maintenance priority는 diagnostic severity와 production, safety, quality, environmental consequence를 결합한다.

sources_checked.citation: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0
sources_checked.supports: Requires risk/context considerations when managing AI-system outcomes.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe a valve maintenance-priority formula or combination of these consequence dimensions.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Priority scoring and escalation thresholds are site risk-management rules; diagnostic severity alone may not be comparable across failure modes.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Use the owner's asset criticality/work-order priority policy and define how diagnostic confidence and consequence affect priority.

reviews.statement: HART·Fieldbus·asset-management integration에서는 update rate, communication quality와 configuration governance를 확인한다.

sources_checked.citation: FieldComm Group, HART Technology overview
sources_checked.supports: Describes HART digital communication and device integration context.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe one universal update-rate, quality metric or configuration-governance checklist across HART and fieldbus asset-management deployments.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Integration behavior depends on protocol revision, host, gateway and device capabilities; required update rate is application-specific.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Use the exact protocol/profile/device/host configuration and document measured update/quality requirements and change controls.

reviews.statement: Offline signature test는 process interruption, full-stroke risk, mechanical limit와 safety authorization을 검토한다.

sources_checked.citation: Emerson Fisher FIELDVUE DVC6200 SIS Instruction Manual D103557X012
sources_checked.supports: Documents partial-stroke test setup, target movement and configured failure response for the product.
sources_checked.gap: Does not define a universal offline signature risk assessment or approval procedure for all process valves.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Test risk and authorization are process/SIF/site-specific; a full stroke may be unsafe or infeasible in service.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Use the process operating procedure, SRS, test plan and exact device limits to assess process and personnel risk before testing.

reviews.statement: Repair 전 as-found와 repair 후 as-left signature를 work-order result와 연결해 diagnostic rule을 검증한다.

sources_checked.citation: Emerson, FIELDVUE signature baseline and comparison
sources_checked.supports: Describes comparing signatures across maintenance/operating periods for a product-specific diagnostic use.
sources_checked.gap: Does not mandate work-order linkage or establish a universal rule-validation feedback process.

reviews.unresolved_reason: This is a sound data-governance proposal, but work-order schema, signature retention and diagnostic-rule validation are site-specific.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Cite the site's work-order and diagnostic-model change-control process and define required links/validation outcomes.

reviews.statement: Final verification은 baseline, trend, alarm, physical inspection, repair와 as-left result를 closed-loop로 교차 확인한다.

sources_checked.citation: Emerson, Control Valve Diagnostics
sources_checked.supports: Describes diagnostics and recommended actions to identify components that may need maintenance.
sources_checked.gap: Does not specify this universal final-verification loop or define closure criteria for all diagnostics and repairs.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The closure sequence is a proposed maintenance-management workflow and should not be treated as a universal vendor-validated procedure.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Define outcome verification and closure criteria in the site maintenance procedure, tied to the fault mode and risk.

reviews.statement: Final-element boundary에는 logic solver output부터 process isolation 또는 depressurization 기능이 실제로 달성되는 지점까지의 component와 interface를 포함한다. Boundary 누락은 PFDavg, response time과 proof-test coverage를 왜곡한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 61511-1:2016, Functional safety—SIS for process industry
sources_checked.supports: SIS includes devices necessary to carry out each SIF from sensors to final elements.
sources_checked.gap: Public summary does not define this anchor's exact output-to-process-effect boundary or quantify the impact of every omitted interface.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Exact subsystem boundary depends on SIF definition, process effect, shared utilities and plant architecture; the phrase 'until achieved' needs a specific SRS boundary.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Show the SIF boundary diagram and trace each device/interface against the SRS and the reliability model.

reviews.statement: Trip signal chain은 logic solver output, relay 또는 output module, solenoid energization state, actuator pressure change, valve movement와 process effect의 순서로 추적한다. 신호 확인만으로 process safe state 달성을 증명할 수 없다.

sources_checked.citation: UK HSE, Control Systems—COMAH Technical Measures Guidance
sources_checked.supports: Final elements and signal conversion are part of the safety-related control function.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe this exact universal sequence or every architecture's energized/de-energized logic.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The order and signal polarity depend on output architecture, solenoid type, actuator action and process end-state.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Verify against the actual cause-and-effect, wiring/pneumatic diagrams, SRS and end-to-end functional test.

reviews.statement: Dangerous failure에는 demand 시 이동 불가, 잘못된 방향 이동, 요구 시간 초과, required isolation 미달, solenoid sticking, actuator leakage와 hidden mechanical seizure가 포함될 수 있다.

sources_checked.citation: Emerson, Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 12
sources_checked.supports: Names selected dangerous undetected examples such as shaft sticking, packing and actuator air-line issues.
sources_checked.gap: Does not validate the complete list, classification or applicability for all actuator/valve designs and SIF demands.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Failure classification requires a defined safety function and device-specific FMEDA; this broad list mixes failure modes and performance consequences.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Map each included failure mode to the specific valve train FMEDA and the required safe action/time/leakage criteria.

reviews.statement: Actuator thrust, torque, spring sizing와 breakaway margin은 Topic 1의 기계 설계 소유 범위이다. Topic 15에서는 worst-case utility와 process load에서 safe action과 response time이 달성되는지 acceptance evidence로 연결한다.

sources_checked.citation: ISA-TR96.05.02-2022, In-Situ Proof Testing of Automated Valves
sources_checked.supports: Discusses actuator capacity versus valve operating requirements and margin analysis.
sources_checked.gap: Does not establish this repository's Topic 1 ownership assignment or a universal worst-case load envelope.

reviews.unresolved_reason: This anchor combines an internal topic handoff with application-specific engineering acceptance; no single load/force margin is specified.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Retain the cross-topic boundary as structure and link actual actuator sizing calculation, SRS and acceptance test conditions for each SIF.

reviews.statement: Fail action은 air failure 또는 power failure 시 장치의 기계적 방향이고, Safe State는 hazard-based process requirement이다. 두 개념이 일치하는지 SRS와 cause-and-effect에서 확인한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 61511-1:2016, Functional safety—SIS for process industry
sources_checked.supports: SIS is specified to achieve or maintain a safe state of the process.
sources_checked.gap: Does not establish that 'fail action' has a universally separate terminology/definition from safe state for each valve product.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Core distinction is plausible but exact failure utilities and process safe state must be traced to this SIF's design basis; wording risks conflating product fail position with hazard outcome.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Use manufacturer actuator documentation plus SRS/cause-and-effect to verify power/air loss action and whether it achieves the required safe state.

reviews.statement: Failure rate는 dangerous detected, dangerous undetected, safe detected와 safe undetected 등 분석 목적에 맞게 구분한다. PFDavg 또는 PFH 계산에는 적용 mode와 diagnostic assumption에 맞는 rate만 사용한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 61508-6:2010, Guidelines on application of IEC 61508-2 and IEC 61508-3
sources_checked.supports: Provides hardware failure probability calculation and diagnostic-coverage guidance.
sources_checked.gap: Public catalogue summary does not expose detailed definitions and classification rules for all four failure categories.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The four-way taxonomy and rate use are standard concepts but require exact definition/denominator and operating-mode assumptions from the applicable standard and device FMEDA.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Check the exact IEC/ISA clause definitions and verify the selected FMEDA failure-rate table and diagnostic assumptions before registration.

reviews.statement: SIL target을 component label로 대체하지 않는다. SIF 전체 PFDavg 또는 PFH budget에서 final element에 할당된 목표와 sensor·logic solver 기여를 함께 관리한다.

sources_checked.citation: UK HSE, Control Systems—COMAH Technical Measures Guidance
sources_checked.supports: Requires a reliability model and comparison of predicted system integrity to the target; proprietary subsystem SIL claims do not by themselves demonstrate SIF achievement.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe a universal budget allocation method among sensors, logic solver and final element.

reviews.unresolved_reason: SIF-level verification is supported, but allocation method and numeric component budget are analysis/design dependent and absent from this Anchor.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Use a documented SIF verification model and allocation rationale with actual subsystem data and dependency assumptions.

reviews.statement: Final-element response time은 Process Safety Time 또는 SRS의 allowable time보다 짧아야 한다. Margin은 worst-case supply, process load, temperature, friction와 communication delay에서 확인한다.

sources_checked.citation: UK HSE, Control Systems—COMAH Technical Measures Guidance
sources_checked.supports: Lists speed of response and adequate margins between normal and safe limits as safety-related performance considerations.
sources_checked.gap: Does not validate this complete list of worst-case conditions or the required numeric response-time margin for every SIF.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The response-time requirement is SIF-specific and depends on defined process safety time and tested worst-case operating envelope.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Trace allowable response time to hazard analysis/SRS and measure the installed full loop under documented worst credible conditions.

reviews.statement: 간단한 serial chain에서는 solenoid delay, actuator pressurization 또는 venting time과 valve travel time을 합산해 final-element response를 screen할 수 있다. Overlap 또는 dynamic interaction이 크면 measured package response를 우선한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 61511-1:2016, Functional safety—SIS for process industry
sources_checked.supports: Requires SIS to achieve its specified safety function; response timing is part of application performance verification.
sources_checked.gap: Public summary does not endorse this component-time summation method or specify how to handle overlapping/dynamic effects.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The screening method is an engineering approximation, not a universal response model; component timing may overlap and depend on instrumentation/utility dynamics.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Document the timing definition and model assumptions; validate against end-to-end measurement for the installed package.

reviews.statement: Trip time acceptance는 normal workshop condition이 아니라 minimum utility pressure, maximum differential pressure, extreme temperature, aging friction와 actual tubing volume 등 worst credible condition을 반영한다.

sources_checked.citation: ISA-TR96.05.02-2022, In-Situ Proof Testing of Automated Valves
sources_checked.supports: Connects valve design/testing with normal and worst-case conditions and discusses acceptance criteria.
sources_checked.gap: Does not validate this exact universal list of worst-case variables; their significance depends on actuator, process, installation and environment.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The list may omit or overstate controlling variables for a given valve train and gives no test method/acceptance bound.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Derive worst credible conditions from SRS, actuator sizing, process differential pressure and installed pneumatic/electrical configuration.

reviews.statement: Test는 normal energized state와 de-energized trip path, output module fault, loss of utility와 restoration path를 구분한다. 단일 manual stroke로 전체 trip path가 검증되었다고 판단하지 않는다.

sources_checked.citation: Emerson, Final Element SIL Verification Report
sources_checked.supports: Example proof procedure de-energizes solenoid, measures closure, confirms safe state and then restores normal state/bypass.
sources_checked.gap: This is a particular modeled valve/SIF proof-test example, not a universal test matrix for output faults and utility-loss conditions.

reviews.unresolved_reason: A complete test matrix must match architecture and avoid unsafe induced failures; the proposed conditions cannot be universalized.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Use exact cause-and-effect, output circuit and device proof-test procedure to define authorized trip-path coverage and restoration checks.

reviews.statement: Redundant final elements의 common-cause failure는 beta-factor 등 적용 가능한 방법으로 평가할 수 있다. Beta 값은 universal constant가 아니며 installation, environment, maintenance와 shared utility 근거가 필요하다.

sources_checked.citation: UK HSE, Control Systems—COMAH Technical Measures Guidance
sources_checked.supports: Requires protection against common-mode failures and considers independence from common utilities and other protective systems.
sources_checked.gap: Does not establish the beta-factor model's scope, parameter selection or an installation-specific beta value.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Common-cause analysis is required conceptually, but choosing beta-factor versus another method and parameter requires the SIF architecture and evidence.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Cite the selected IEC/ISA CCF method and justify beta using design, environment, maintenance and shared-resource evidence.

reviews.statement: 1oo2 또는 2oo3 architecture의 위험감소 credit은 physical, electrical, pneumatic, environmental와 maintenance independence가 확보될 때만 인정한다. 단순한 valve 수 증가만으로 independence를 증명할 수 없다.

sources_checked.citation: UK HSE, Control Systems—COMAH Technical Measures Guidance
sources_checked.supports: Describes fault tolerance/redundancy for random failures and independence from common utilities, shared management systems and other protection systems for systematic/common-mode risk.
sources_checked.gap: Does not validate this exact universal checklist of independence dimensions or guarantee credit for a particular 1oo2/2oo3 design.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Architecture-specific common-cause and dependency assessment is required; the Anchor's list is illustrative but sounds like a sufficient universal condition.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Review the SIF architecture, separation, shared utilities, environment, maintenance/testing dependencies and applicable hardware fault tolerance rules.

reviews.statement: Online PST는 spurious trip, process disturbance, seat damage와 incomplete restoration 위험을 가진다. Stroke limit, permissive, rate limit, abort logic, operator notification와 post-test confirmation을 설계한다.

sources_checked.citation: ISA-TR96.05.01-2017, Partial Stroke Testing of Automated Valves
sources_checked.supports: Discusses PST operational characteristics, spurious-trip potential, over-torquing risks and maintenance considerations.
sources_checked.gap: Does not require every listed control for every method or quantify the seat-damage risk and control effectiveness universally.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The risk categories and safeguards depend on PST method, valve/process design and site operating practice; fixed safeguards need a hazard review.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Define method-specific hazard analysis, abort behavior, travel limit, operator coordination and restoration proof in the approved procedure.

reviews.statement: PST interval을 단축하면 selected hidden failures의 exposure를 줄일 수 있지만 test-induced failure와 operational burden이 증가할 수 있다. Coverage와 demand exposure를 함께 최적화한다.

sources_checked.citation: Emerson, Partial Stroke Testing
sources_checked.supports: Describes using online PST when more frequent testing is needed and explains testing frequency as related to safety-analysis assumptions.
sources_checked.gap: Does not provide a universal optimization criterion balancing coverage, demand exposure, test-induced failure and operational burden.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Trade-off is analytically plausible but requires a reliability model and plant-specific demand/test-induced risk data.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Compare candidate intervals in the verified SIF model including PFDavg, PST failure/spurious trip, demand exposure, repair and operational constraints.

reviews.statement: Valve signature와 predictive diagnostics의 일반 원리는 Topic 12가 소유한다. Topic 15에서는 SIF final element에 credit을 부여할 수 있는지와 proof-test evidence로 사용할 수 있는지를 제한적으로 평가한다.

sources_checked.citation: ISA-TR96.05.01-2017, Partial Stroke Testing of Automated Valves
sources_checked.supports: Covers diagnostic approaches and coverage for PST methods.
sources_checked.gap: Does not establish this repository's Topic 12/15 ownership boundary or validate credit for a specific signature/diagnostic without failure-mode evidence.

reviews.unresolved_reason: This is mostly an internal topic handoff; any safety credit is device-, configuration- and FMEDA-dependent and cannot be generalized from a signature plot alone.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Keep taxonomy as structural scope; for any SIF credit, use the applicable certified FMEDA, failure-mode mapping and validated procedure.

reviews.statement: Proof-test record에는 asset identity, SIF tag, procedure revision, test date, as-found result, failure mode, repair, as-left result, bypass duration, restoration verification와 reviewer를 추적 가능하게 기록한다.

sources_checked.citation: UK HSE, Control Systems—COMAH Technical Measures Guidance
sources_checked.supports: Calls for proof-test procedures, test results and records, and management of overrides.
sources_checked.gap: Does not mandate the Anchor's exact universal data-field list for each proof-test record.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The proposed traceability fields are reasonable governance design, but the exact required record schema is site/document-control policy dependent.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Map required fields to the owner's functional-safety management system, test procedure, MOC and audit requirements.

reviews.statement: FMECA 또는 FMEDA와 vendor failure data는 device type, service, environment, useful life, proof-test coverage, diagnostic configuration와 repair assumption을 확인한다. Certificate만으로 application suitability를 보증하지 않는다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 61508-6:2010, Guidelines on application of IEC 61508-2 and IEC 61508-3
sources_checked.supports: Provides guidance and examples for hardware failure probability and diagnostic coverage calculations.
sources_checked.gap: Public summary does not enumerate this entire data-quality checklist or establish suitability of any specific certificate/vendor dataset.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The data-assumption principle is sound but the checklist's completeness and specific suitability test require the exact FMEDA/certificate and application conditions.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Review the actual device safety manual/FMEDA and verify model, configuration, environment, useful life, test coverage and repair assumptions against the installation.

reviews.statement: Feasibility 단계는 기술성, 기존 설비 인터페이스, 일정, 비용, 인력, 위험과 기대효과를 평가하여 수행 가능성과 대안을 결정한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 62381:2024, Automation systems in the process industry—FAT, SAT and SIT
sources_checked.supports: Addresses testing/acceptance planning and roles for automation-system delivery.
sources_checked.gap: Does not define a universal feasibility study checklist or decision thresholds for schedule, cost, resources and benefits.

reviews.unresolved_reason: This is a project-management recommendation rather than a single technical fact; criteria and feasibility decision are organization/project dependent.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Treat as a recommended checklist and identify the owner's project governance/feasibility standard before making it a required answer anchor.

reviews.statement: Scope는 대상 공정·시스템, 포함·제외 범위, 경계 인터페이스, 산출물, 책임, 수용기준을 정의하고 승인된 baseline으로 관리한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 62381:2024, Automation systems in the process industry—FAT, SAT and SIT
sources_checked.supports: Emphasizes agreed scope of activities and responsibilities for testing and acceptance.
sources_checked.gap: Does not establish the Anchor's complete scope-baseline field list or universal approval workflow.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The listed scope fields are plausible governance practice but should not be presented as a universal normative minimum without a project standard.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Link to the owner's approved project execution/change-control procedure and scope baseline template.

reviews.statement: Schedule은 설계승인, 구매·제작, 소프트웨어 구현, 시험환경, FAT, 현장설치, SAT, 시운전과 인수의 선후관계 및 critical path를 반영한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 62381:2024, Automation systems in the process industry—FAT, SAT and SIT
sources_checked.supports: Identifies distinct testing stages from vendor site to site integration before startup.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe all project schedule dependencies, procurement activities or a critical-path method.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The activities and dependencies vary by contract, procurement strategy, system and site; no universal critical path is established.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Validate the sequence and dependencies against project execution plan, contract milestones and integrated schedule.

reviews.statement: Cost는 인력·장비·라이선스·시험·현장지원·예비품·교육을 포함하고, 범위변경은 영향분석과 승인 후 예산·일정 baseline에 반영한다.

sources_checked.citation: UK HSE, Plant Modification / Change Procedures
sources_checked.supports: Calls for technical review and formal authorization of plant changes and maintaining design intent.
sources_checked.gap: Does not establish a universal project cost-element list or a particular budget/schedule baseline process.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Cost categories and change approval are contract/governance-specific; the exact cost list is not exhaustive or universal.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Use the organization's cost-control and management-of-change procedure and specify project accounting scope.

reviews.statement: Control philosophy는 운전목표, 제어구조, 운전모드, 자동·수동 전환, Alarm·Interlock 원칙, Fail-safe와 비정상 운전 대응의 상위 기준이다.

sources_checked.citation: UK HSE, Control Systems—COMAH Technical Measures Guidance
sources_checked.supports: Discusses hazard-derived safety functions, control-system design, alarms, trips and lifecycle requirements.
sources_checked.gap: Does not define one universal control-philosophy document structure or require the exact listed contents in a single document.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Control philosophy terminology and document partition vary by owner, sector and project; portions may be owned by separate safety/alarm standards.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Verify against the owner's control-system design basis, alarm philosophy and cause-and-effect governance.

reviews.statement: URS는 사용자가 필요로 하는 기능, 성능, 운전환경, 규제·품질, 인터페이스와 인수조건을 사용자 관점에서 정의한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 62381:2024, Automation systems in the process industry—FAT, SAT and SIT
sources_checked.supports: Highlights roles of owners, vendors and agreed test scope/responsibilities.
sources_checked.gap: Does not define a universal URS template, lifecycle content or all user-requirement categories.

reviews.unresolved_reason: URS is a common engineering artifact but its exact content, regulatory scope and acceptance detail depend on sector and governance standard.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Cite the applicable sector/owner requirements-specification standard and distinguish mandatory from optional URS sections.

reviews.statement: FRS는 URS를 기능별 입력·처리·출력, 운전모드, Alarm·Interlock, 예외처리와 성능 요구로 구체화한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 62381:2024, Automation systems in the process industry—FAT, SAT and SIT
sources_checked.supports: Test planning covers automation functions, interfaces and acceptance evidence.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe FRS terminology, a URS-to-FRS transformation or an exhaustive functional specification schema.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The acronym and engineering deliverable layering differ among suppliers and projects; the content list cannot be asserted as universal.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Use the project software/system lifecycle standard and approved specification templates to substantiate this hierarchy.

reviews.statement: FDS는 기능 요구를 제어전략, 시퀀스, 화면, 데이터, 인터페이스, 권한과 진단 동작으로 설계 수준에서 정의한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 62381:2024, Automation systems in the process industry—FAT, SAT and SIT
sources_checked.supports: Includes test consideration of software, operator interfaces and communications.
sources_checked.gap: Does not define FDS as one mandatory deliverable or specify its exact content fields.

reviews.unresolved_reason: FDS scope and separation from control narrative, functional specification and design documents are vendor/project-dependent.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Check the contract deliverable register and the applicable owner/industry specification standard.

reviews.statement: SDS는 소프트웨어 모듈, 데이터 구조, 태스크, 통신, I/O 처리, 상태관리와 구현 제약을 상세 수준에서 정의한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 61508-3:2010, Software requirements for E/E/PE safety-related systems
sources_checked.supports: Covers software safety requirements and lifecycle activities for safety-related software.
sources_checked.gap: Does not define this generic SDS content list as a universal project deliverable for all control software.

reviews.unresolved_reason: SDS is not a universally standardized document name/content; safety-related software lifecycle requirements may differ from general DCS/PLC projects.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Identify the project lifecycle standard, software classification and contractual document template.

reviews.statement: URS→FRS→FDS→SDS→시험명세→시험결과의 식별자와 양방향 추적을 유지하여 누락, 과잉구현과 미시험 요구를 검출한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 61508-3:2010, Software requirements for E/E/PE safety-related systems
sources_checked.supports: Requires lifecycle controls and evidence for safety-related software development.
sources_checked.gap: Public summary does not prescribe this exact document acronym sequence or a universal bidirectional traceability matrix format.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Traceability is an established lifecycle control, but exact URS/FRS/FDS/SDS hierarchy is not universal and may misstate specific standard terminology.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Retain the traceability principle but cite the applicable lifecycle standard and map project-specific artifacts without treating the acronym chain as mandatory.

reviews.statement: I/O list는 채널·주소, 신호형식, 범위·단위, 정상·고장값, 절연·전원, 스케일링과 연결 대상을 정의한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 62382:2024, Control systems in the process industry—Electrical and instrumentation loop check
sources_checked.supports: Defines loop-check activity and generic loop-check form, including agreement among owner, installer and vendor.
sources_checked.gap: Does not establish this full universal I/O-list field set or require every field for each signal type.

reviews.unresolved_reason: I/O metadata depends on signal/device type, architecture, owner database and project practice; not all listed fields apply universally.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Compare with the project's approved I/O database schema and instrument/functional design requirements.

reviews.statement: Tag list는 설비·계기·소프트웨어 객체의 고유 Tag, 명칭, 위치, 서비스와 관련 문서 식별자를 관리한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 62382:2024, Control systems in the process industry—Electrical and instrumentation loop check
sources_checked.supports: Addresses loop identification and agreed loop-check records in instrumentation systems.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe one universal tag register schema spanning equipment, software objects and document identifiers.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Tagging conventions and asset database fields depend on owner standards and applicable identification standards.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Cite the site's tag-numbering/asset-information standard and verify which object classes it governs.

reviews.statement: Alarm list는 Tag, 조건, 설정값, 우선순위, 지연·Deadband, 메시지와 운전자 조치를 직접 기록하거나 식별자로 연결된 승인 문서에서 관리하고 시험기준까지 추적한다.

sources_checked.citation: UK HSE, Control Systems—COMAH Technical Measures Guidance
sources_checked.supports: Includes alarms and trips as control-system safety functions and calls for testing/verification.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe this exact alarm-list record schema or require all fields in one register.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Alarm management standards and project registers vary; priority, deadband, delay and operator-response documentation may be separated into approved artifacts.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Map fields to the site's alarm philosophy, alarm rationalization record and configuration/test documents.

reviews.statement: Interlock list는 원인, 허용조건, 차단대상, 동작과 Latch·Reset을 정의하고 Bypass 권한, Fail-safe와 시험정보는 해당 문서 또는 식별자로 연결된 승인 문서에서 관리할 수 있다.

sources_checked.citation: UK HSE, Control Systems—COMAH Technical Measures Guidance
sources_checked.supports: Calls for protective-system trip testing and override management.
sources_checked.gap: Does not specify a universal interlock-list format or mandate the exact fields and linked documents.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Interlock documentation structure and required fields depend on control-system and SIS design, cause-and-effect conventions and owner practice.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Check approved cause-and-effect, functional design specification, bypass procedure and test record for the actual project.

reviews.statement: Cause & Effect는 각 원인 신호와 Alarm·Trip·Shutdown·출력동작의 관계를 행렬로 표현하고 지연, Voting, Latch·Reset과 우선순위는 행렬 또는 식별자로 연결된 승인 문서에서 관리할 수 있다.

sources_checked.citation: UK HSE, Control Systems—COMAH Technical Measures Guidance
sources_checked.supports: Describes hazard-derived safety functions and testing alarms/trips.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe cause-and-effect matrix representation or its exact fields as a universal method.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Cause-and-effect is a common engineering representation but detailed data layout, voting and priority fields are design- and project-specific.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Verify against approved SRS/cause-and-effect design standard and actual safety logic implementation.

reviews.statement: Logic diagram은 Boolean 조건, Sequence·State, Timer, Interlock, 명령·Feedback과 예외경로를 구현 가능한 형태로 나타낸다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 61131-3:2025, Programmable controllers—Programming languages
sources_checked.supports: Defines programming-language syntax and semantics for programmable controllers.
sources_checked.gap: Does not define a universal logic-diagram deliverable or require the Anchor's combined notation/content.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Logic diagram format and relationship to executable application code differ across vendor tools, project standards and lifecycle models.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Identify the project's logic design representation standard and compare against implemented PLC/DCS/SIS logic.

reviews.statement: Test specification은 시험목적, 대상 baseline, 사전조건, 입력·절차, 예상결과, 허용오차, 판정기준, 증적과 결함처리를 정의한다.

sources_checked.citation: UK HSE, Control Systems—COMAH Technical Measures Guidance
sources_checked.supports: Requires proof-test procedures to specify success/failure criteria and safe execution arrangements.
sources_checked.gap: Does not establish this full universal specification template or require each field for every project test.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The proposed test-specification fields are good practice but exact content depends on test type, standard, contract and quality system.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Reference the approved project verification/validation plan and test procedure template for mandatory fields.

reviews.statement: Site integration test는 DCS·PLC·SIS·패키지 설비·상위시스템 간 데이터, 명령, Handshake, 시간동기, 장애복구와 운전 시나리오를 확인한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 62381:2024, Automation systems in the process industry—FAT, SAT and SIT
sources_checked.supports: Includes site integration testing and communications/interfaces as part of automation system acceptance framework.
sources_checked.gap: Does not validate this exact universal set of time synchronization, recovery and operating scenarios for every integrated system.

reviews.unresolved_reason: SIT content depends on system interfaces, risk, time-critical functions and contract acceptance criteria.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Use interface register, system architecture and risk-based integrated test plan to select and validate test scenarios.

reviews.statement: Performance test는 처리량, 품질, 제어편차, 응답시간, 가용성, Alarm 부하 등 계약 성능을 정의된 조건·기간·측정방법과 허용기준으로 검증한다.

sources_checked.citation: UK HSE, Design Codes—Plant, COMAH Technical Measures Guidance
sources_checked.supports: Calls for witnessed performance tests and certificates of plant-performance acceptance where applicable.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe this universal automation performance metric set, test duration or acceptance thresholds.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Performance metrics and guarantees are contract- and process-specific; the Anchor's examples do not apply to every control system.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Tie each metric to the contract guarantee, measurement uncertainty, operating envelope and approved acceptance procedure.

reviews.statement: Acceptance는 승인된 범위와 요구사항, FAT·SAT·시운전·성능시험 결과, 문서, 교육, 예비품과 잔여 Punch 조건을 종합하여 계약상 수락을 결정한다.

sources_checked.citation: UK HSE, Design Codes—Plant, COMAH Technical Measures Guidance
sources_checked.supports: Lists plant-performance acceptance certificates, witnessed testing and handover documentation as evidence that may be required.
sources_checked.gap: Does not define a universal contract-acceptance bundle or permit/require acceptance with particular punch-list conditions.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Acceptance is a contractual decision and its documents, training, spares and outstanding-work conditions are project-specific.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Use contract acceptance clauses and approved punch-list/turnover criteria; avoid asserting a universal evidence bundle.

reviews.statement: Punch list는 결함·미완료 항목을 안전·운전 영향과 인수조건에 따라 등급화하고 책임자, 목표일, 임시조치, 재시험과 closure 증적을 관리한다.

sources_checked.citation: ISA-105 Series of Standards, overview of IEC 62381:2024
sources_checked.supports: Mentions punch-list tracking and defined completion criteria in FAT/SAT/SIT framework.
sources_checked.gap: Does not specify this full universal classification, ownership, temporary measure and closure-record schema.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Punch management fields and acceptance severity categories are project governance choices; safety-critical open items require site-specific disposition.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Cite contract turnover procedure and define criticality/closure criteria in the approved project quality plan.

reviews.statement: As-built와 Handover는 최종 설치·설정·버전·배선·Logic·목록, 백업·복구절차, 시험증적, 매뉴얼, 교육과 유지보수 정보를 실제 상태와 일치시켜 인계한다.

sources_checked.citation: UK HSE, Design Codes—Plant, COMAH Technical Measures Guidance
sources_checked.supports: Calls for as-built discrepancy checks, handover certificates and commissioning/acceptance records.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe the Anchor's complete handover package or exact backup/training/maintenance deliverables for all projects.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The listed records are generally useful but actual turnover requirements depend on contract, asset owner and system criticality.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Verify deliverables against contract, owner turnover standard, configuration-management plan and operations-maintenance requirements.

reviews.statement: 프로젝트 전 과정에서 하드웨어·소프트웨어·Firmware·라이브러리·설정·문서 baseline과 백업을 식별하고 배포·복구 가능성을 확인한다.

sources_checked.citation: UK HSE, Control Systems—COMAH Technical Measures Guidance
sources_checked.supports: Includes control of software backups and memory media within maintenance procedures.
sources_checked.gap: Does not mandate this complete baseline inventory and recovery test process across all hardware/software/document classes.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Configuration and backup controls are appropriate but exact scope and recovery verification frequency require owner lifecycle/security policy and system criticality.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Map to approved configuration-management, backup/restore, cybersecurity and disaster-recovery requirements for the project.

reviews.statement: FAT 이후 변경과 Punch 수정은 영향분석, 승인, 문서·baseline 갱신, 선택된 회귀시험, 결과 승인과 closure까지 폐루프로 관리한다.

sources_checked.citation: UK HSE, Plant Modification / Change Procedures
sources_checked.supports: Requires formal technical review/authorization of modifications, testing and proof that design intent is achieved.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe the exact FAT-after-change regression and punch-closure workflow or required approvers for every project.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Change-control principle is supported but exact post-FAT regression scope and closure authority depend on project configuration and risk.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Reference the project's MOC and software configuration-control procedures and define regression selection/approval rules.

reviews.statement: Hardware architecture는 power/protection, controller/processing, analog·digital I/O, communication, isolation, terminal/interface, enclosure·thermal 영역을 기능별로 partitioning하여 fault propagation, maintainability와 verification boundary를 명확히 한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 61010-1:2010+A1:2016, Safety requirements for electrical equipment for measurement, control and laboratory use
sources_checked.supports: Addresses safety requirements for measurement/control equipment and protection against hazards.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe this architecture partitioning taxonomy or require all listed blocks in every product.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The partition list is an engineering design pattern whose boundaries vary by product architecture and hazard analysis.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Cite the applicable product architecture/design standard and identify which partitions are required for the target product.

reviews.statement: 각 hardware block 간 interface는 signal type/range, electrical level, source/load capability, isolation, connector/terminal, timing 또는 communication condition과 fault behavior를 정의하여 암묵적 interface assumption을 줄인다.

sources_checked.supports: Defines equipment safety requirements and interfaces insofar as electrical hazards and protection are concerned.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe this complete hardware-interface specification field list or a universal interface-control document.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The interface fields depend on signal and product type; the anchor is prescriptive without a specific design standard or interface definition.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Verify the interface-control specification against applicable electrical, EMC, communications and functional requirements for the product.

reviews.statement: Hardware power design은 normal/peak/startup load, supply tolerance, conversion loss, protection device와 future margin을 포함해 power budget을 작성하고 branch별 voltage/current capability와 brownout·fault response를 검증한다.

sources_checked.supports: Contains safety requirements relevant to electrical supply and protection of measurement/control equipment.
sources_checked.gap: Does not define this universal power-budget component list or a future-margin percentage; load profiles and brownout requirements are product-specific.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The categories are candidate design inputs, but their completeness and margin depend on load transients, supply architecture and product requirements.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Review the actual load table, startup profiles, converter efficiency, tolerance envelope and project-approved margin criteria.

reviews.statement: Power input과 distribution에는 적용 requirement에 따라 overcurrent, reverse polarity, over/undervoltage, surge/transient, short-circuit 또는 branch isolation protection을 배치하고 protection coordination과 정상동작 영향도 함께 검토한다.

sources_checked.supports: Establishes safety requirements and protective measures for measurement/control equipment.
sources_checked.gap: Does not require every listed protection function for every supply design or specify coordination settings without product/application context.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Protection selection is application-, supply- and regulatory-category-dependent; list should not be treated as a mandatory stack.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Tie each protection device to hazard analysis, supply characteristics and applicable product safety/EMC requirements.

reviews.statement: Component selection은 nominal 기능만 맞추는 것이 아니라 electrical rating, temperature/environment, tolerance/accuracy requirement, derating margin, interface compatibility, availability/lifecycle, maintainability, quality grade와 application/safety requirement를 함께 평가한다.

sources_checked.supports: Requires equipment safety design to account for electrical and environmental hazards within applicable scope.
sources_checked.gap: Does not define this complete universal selection matrix or prescribe a derating margin/quality grade for all components.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Selection criteria and their weighting are application-specific, and the Anchor's broad list is a decision framework rather than a universally fixed fact.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Use the product requirements, component datasheets and owner derating/obsolescence/quality policies to define the applicable selection criteria.

reviews.statement: 장기 운영 제어시스템의 component selection은 lifecycle status, second source 가능성, supply continuity와 replacement compatibility를 고려하여 단종이나 공급중단이 유지보수와 생산에 미치는 위험을 줄인다.

sources_checked.citation: NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 3, Supply Chain Risk Management
sources_checked.supports: Addresses supply-chain risk management across design, manufacturing, acquisition, integration, operations, maintenance and disposal.
sources_checked.gap: Does not specify a universal component second-source or replacement-compatibility process for industrial control hardware.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The lifecycle-risk principle is broadly sound, but the selection factors and required evidence depend on procurement, safety approval and replacement constraints.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Cite the asset owner's obsolescence and spare-parts policy and document how substitutions are requalified for the specific design.

reviews.statement: Panel/product thermal design은 component loss, enclosure 내부 heat accumulation, ambient condition, ventilation/cooling path와 hotspot을 고려하고 온도상승이 component rating·reliability를 침해하지 않는지 계산 또는 시험 evidence로 검증한다.

sources_checked.supports: Includes temperature and fire-related safety requirements within the standard's equipment scope.
sources_checked.gap: Does not define a universal enclosure thermal model or demonstrate this particular design's thermal behavior.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Thermal design is valid engineering concern but this anchor lacks product losses, enclosure geometry, ambient limits and calculation/test method.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Provide the product-specific thermal calculation or temperature-rise test with component limits, worst ambient and airflow assumptions.

reviews.statement: Panel architecture의 physical layout은 power/heat/noise source와 sensitive I/O, maintenance clearance, airflow, terminal accessibility, cable entry와 replaceability를 고려하여 functional partition과 physical arrangement가 일치하도록 구성한다.

sources_checked.supports: Addresses safety-related construction and protection of measurement/control equipment.
sources_checked.gap: Does not verify this full panel layout checklist or establish layout dimensions/clearance for a particular installation.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The checklist contains context-specific thermal, EMC, serviceability and installation concerns with no stated enclosure or environment.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Use applicable enclosure, EMC, thermal and electrical-installation requirements plus the actual panel drawing and service-clearance criteria.

reviews.statement: I/O module과 signal-conditioning hardware는 signal type/range, input impedance or loading, output drive, isolation, conversion accuracy/resolution, update requirement, diagnostic capability와 fault state를 application requirement에 맞게 선정한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 61131-2:2017, Programmable controllers—Equipment requirements and tests
sources_checked.supports: Specifies functional and EMC requirements and tests for PLC equipment, including I/O-related characteristics within scope.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe this entire selection checklist for all analog/digital I/O types or all process applications.

reviews.unresolved_reason: I/O selection needs signal-specific requirements and module datasheets; the anchor combines many candidate criteria without a defined application or thresholds.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Compare each I/O channel requirement against module data, loop loading, resolution/error budget, update time and safe fault response.

reviews.statement: Communication hardware는 physical layer, connector/media, isolation, port count, network load/throughput requirement, redundancy or recovery requirement와 field device compatibility를 확인하며 protocol software 기능과 hardware interface 책임을 구분한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 61131-2:2017, Programmable controllers—Equipment requirements and tests
sources_checked.supports: Provides PLC equipment requirements/tests within the scope of programmable controllers.
sources_checked.gap: Does not define this universal industrial-network hardware-selection matrix; protocol/network requirements vary.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The listed properties are relevant but the expected throughput, recovery, redundancy and compatibility criteria depend on network architecture and application.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Use the selected protocol standards and network design specification to validate physical-layer and capacity requirements.

reviews.statement: Connector와 terminal은 current/voltage rating, conductor size, contact reliability, mating cycle, environmental condition, keying/polarity protection, serviceability와 production assembly error 가능성을 고려하여 선정한다.

sources_checked.supports: Contains requirements relevant to electrical connections and protection against electrical hazards.
sources_checked.gap: Does not validate this full universal connector/terminal criteria list or provide application-specific ratings and mating-cycle limits.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Connector selection needs specific environment, conductor, current, voltage and maintenance lifecycle; the Anchor gives no applicable standard or design values.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Verify exact selected part datasheets, mating-cycle ratings, conductor compatibility and required environmental qualification.

reviews.statement: Prototype의 기능시험 합격은 component availability, tolerance spread, assembly variation, process capability, production test coverage와 configuration control을 입증하지 않으므로 production readiness와 동일하지 않다.

sources_checked.citation: IPC J-STD-001J, Requirements for Soldered Electrical and Electronic Assemblies
sources_checked.supports: Separates assembly process/material requirements from post-assembly acceptance criteria and emphasizes process control.
sources_checked.gap: Does not directly establish this complete prototype-versus-production readiness claim for all hardware product types.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The distinction is reasonable but its specific readiness evidence set is not a universal standard and depends on product and manufacturing maturity criteria.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Define production-readiness criteria in the owner's design-transfer/quality system and cite the applicable manufacturing validation standard.

reviews.statement: Hardware design review는 requirement traceability, architecture/interface consistency, schematic/BOM/layout, power/thermal margin, failure risk, testability, manufacturability와 maintainability를 단계별로 검토하고 open action을 closure evidence로 관리한다.

sources_checked.supports: Provides product safety requirements for measurement/control equipment.
sources_checked.gap: Does not define this universal design-review checklist, stage gates or open-action closure process.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Review domains and gate governance depend on product lifecycle and organizational quality system; list is not a standard-mandated universal checklist.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Reference the design-control procedure and applicable product standard; separate mandatory safety review items from recommended design review topics.

reviews.statement: Prototype/design verification에서는 power, I/O, interface, protection, fault response, thermal behavior, diagnostic path와 requirement-specific 기능을 시험하여 design margin과 failure mode를 확인하고 결과를 requirement에 trace한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 61131-2:2017, Programmable controllers—Equipment requirements and tests
sources_checked.supports: Defines PLC equipment functional and EMC requirements and tests within scope.
sources_checked.gap: Does not establish this exact universal prototype test suite or require every listed test for every product.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The design-verification suite must derive from requirements, hazards, architecture and applicable qualification; the Anchor's test list is broad and unspecific.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Trace each design-verification test to a requirement, hazard/failure mode and acceptance criterion for the selected hardware.

reviews.statement: 양산 전에는 design for manufacturability/assembly 관점에서 부품 방향성, 접근성, 공구·작업공간, 조립순서, 오삽입 방지, 검사 가능성, 반복 작업 편차와 repair/rework 가능성을 검토한다.

sources_checked.citation: IPC J-STD-001J, Requirements for Soldered Electrical and Electronic Assemblies
sources_checked.supports: Covers process controls, materials and acceptance requirements for soldered assemblies.
sources_checked.gap: Does not require this entire DFM/DFA checklist or validate it for non-electronic or non-soldered products.

reviews.unresolved_reason: DFM/DFA is a design method with organization- and process-specific criteria; the Anchor lists suggestions without scope or acceptance rules.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Cite the applicable manufacturing/assembly design standard and document process-specific review criteria and feedback evidence.

reviews.statement: Production control은 critical component와 assembly material의 part identity, approved source, revision, certificate/inspection requirement와 storage/handling 조건을 확인하여 잘못된 또는 미승인 부품 투입을 방지한다.

sources_checked.citation: NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 3, Supply Chain Risk Management
sources_checked.supports: Addresses supply-chain provenance/configuration and component/system risks throughout development and manufacturing.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe this exact incoming-material inspection/certificate/storage checklist for every industrial hardware build.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Incoming inspection and traceability criteria depend on product risk, contract, quality system and component criticality.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Use the applicable QMS, procurement quality clauses and BOM criticality rules to define receipt inspection and traceability.

reviews.statement: 생산 작업은 controlled drawing/BOM/work instruction에 따라 수행하고 crimp, torque, soldering, connector mating, labeling 등 품질에 영향을 주는 공정은 필요한 작업조건·검사방법·tool 상태와 operator evidence를 관리한다.

sources_checked.citation: IPC J-STD-001J, Requirements for Soldered Electrical and Electronic Assemblies
sources_checked.supports: Defines process requirements and materials for soldered electronic assemblies and relies on process-control methodology.
sources_checked.gap: Does not define the listed control method for crimping, labeling and every production process or product class.

reviews.unresolved_reason: The process controls are operation-specific and depend on applicable assembly standards, equipment qualification and quality requirements.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Identify critical processes and cite applicable standards/work instructions, acceptance criteria and tool calibration/verification records.

reviews.statement: Production verification은 설계검증 전체를 반복하는 것이 아니라 제조변동·오조립·부품불량을 검출하도록 unit-level 검사와 functional test coverage를 정의하고 critical path가 실제로 검사되는지 확인한다.

sources_checked.citation: IPC-A-610J, Acceptability of Electronic Assemblies
sources_checked.supports: Defines visual acceptability requirements for electronic assemblies and distinguishes workmanship acceptance from other processes.
sources_checked.gap: Does not specify the test coverage strategy or critical-path testing claimed for all hardware units.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Production-test strategy must be based on product risk, manufacturing variation, requirements and test economics; no universal coverage metric is stated.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Provide the production test strategy with defect model, coverage rationale, traceable requirements and escape-risk validation.

reviews.statement: End-of-line 또는 final production test는 적용 product requirement에 따라 power-up, supply current, I/O channels, communication ports, diagnostics, alarms, protection path와 calibration-related checks 중 필요한 항목을 검증하고 unit-specific result를 기록한다.

sources_checked.citation: IPC-A-610J, Acceptability of Electronic Assemblies
sources_checked.supports: Provides assembly acceptability criteria; related IPC standards address assembly tests and process requirements.
sources_checked.gap: Does not mandate this EOL test list or record format for control-system hardware.

reviews.unresolved_reason: EOL test items vary by product safety function, I/O configuration and manufacturing quality strategy; the anchor intentionally lists optional items but lacks criteria.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Use the product test specification and requirement-to-test matrix to identify mandatory and risk-based EOL tests.

reviews.statement: Production test fixture와 test software는 version, calibration/verification 상태, known-good/reference check와 change control을 관리하여 fixture failure를 product defect로 오판하거나 반대로 defect를 놓치는 위험을 줄인다.

sources_checked.citation: IPC J-STD-001J, Requirements for Soldered Electrical and Electronic Assemblies
sources_checked.supports: Promotes process control for soldered assembly manufacturing.
sources_checked.gap: Does not specify this exact fixture configuration/calibration/reference-check schema for all production test systems.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Fixture controls are appropriate but the exact calibration/verification method, reference unit frequency and software control are process-specific.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Cite the manufacturing test-system validation/calibration procedure and define fixture MSA, reference checks and software version control.

reviews.statement: Production nonconformance는 defect classification, containment, disposition, rework instruction, reinspection/retest와 recurrence prevention evidence를 남기고 임의 repair 후 정상 unit로 출하하지 않는다.

sources_checked.citation: IPC-7711/21C, Rework, Modification and Repair of Electronic Assemblies
sources_checked.supports: Provides procedures for rework, repair and modification of electronic assemblies.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe the complete nonconformance disposition/containment/CAPA workflow for every product or organization.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Rework methods exist, but authorization, classification, retest and corrective-action requirements depend on QMS, product class and contract.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Tie rework and nonconformance disposition to the applicable quality-system standard, approved repair procedure and release authority.

reviews.statement: Component substitution, PCB/panel layout, power design, connector, enclosure 또는 manufacturing process 변경 시 requirement와 verified characteristic에 미치는 영향을 평가하여 필요한 design verification, environmental requalification 또는 production-test update 범위를 결정한다.

sources_checked.citation: NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 3, Supply Chain Risk Management and configuration/provenance controls
sources_checked.supports: Addresses system-component configuration, provenance and supply-chain risk across lifecycle stages.
sources_checked.gap: Does not specify which control-panel changes require environmental requalification or production-test updates.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Impact-analysis principle is broadly sound, but the requalification decision needs change-classification and product-specific validation criteria.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Use the owner's engineering change and requalification rules, linking each affected requirement and verification evidence to the proposed change.

reviews.statement: Hardware release는 open design action, unresolved nonconformance, requirement verification gap, obsolete/unapproved BOM item 또는 production-test gap이 남아 있지 않은지 확인하고 승인된 configuration과 evidence package를 baseline으로 고정한 뒤 수행한다.

sources_checked.citation: NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 3, Configuration Management and Supply Chain Risk Management
sources_checked.supports: Addresses configuration management and supply-chain processes to maintain provenance and control system components.
sources_checked.gap: Does not prescribe this exact hardware design-release gate, zero-open-action rule or evidence-package contents.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Release readiness criteria and permitted open actions are organizational/product governance decisions, not a universal technical fact.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Cite the approved product release/design-control procedure and identify its required approvals, deviation handling and baseline artifacts.

reviews.statement: 설치 작업은 적용 법규·인허가 요구, 프로젝트 Design Basis와 specification, 승인도면, vendor instruction, 적용 표준의 관계를 확인하고 충돌 시 임의 판단하지 않고 승인된 deviation 또는 clarification 절차로 해결한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 60079-14:2024, Explosive atmospheres—Electrical installation design and installation
sources_checked.supports: For Ex installations, addresses design, installation, documentation and personnel competency.
sources_checked.gap: Does not define a universal hierarchy among laws, permits, owner design basis, drawings and vendor instructions for all instrument installation work.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Authority precedence and deviation approval depend on jurisdiction, contract and owner governance; the statement is procedural policy, not a universal technical fact.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Cite the governing project document-control/design-basis procedure and applicable jurisdictional rules.

reviews.statement: 기기 위치, elevation, orientation, tapping point, cable route와 tubing route는 승인도면 및 현장 간섭조건을 기준으로 시공하고 변경사항은 red-line과 as-built에 반영한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 62382:2024, Control systems in the process industry—Electrical and instrumentation loop check
sources_checked.supports: Covers installed loop construction and agreed loop-check scope after installation.
sources_checked.gap: Does not define project drawing authority or red-line/as-built workflow for all field installation changes.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Drawing compliance and red-line control are project governance practices; exact requirements must come from approved construction documents and change control.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Use project construction/red-line procedure and demonstrate against the issued-for-construction and as-built drawing revisions.

reviews.statement: 계기는 운전·교정·분리·배수·vent·점검이 가능한 접근성을 확보하고, 주변 구조물·배관·열원·진동원과의 간섭 및 정비공간을 확인한다.

sources_checked.citation: Emerson, Rosemount 4051S Pressure Transmitter Manual
sources_checked.supports: Recommends considering easy access, personnel safety, field calibration and suitable environment for transmitter installation.
sources_checked.gap: Does not validate the complete access/clearance/interference list for all instruments and installations.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Access and maintenance clearance depend on equipment, process hazard, layout and owner standards; there is no universal dimension or complete checklist in the cited source.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Verify against plot plan, instrument datasheet, maintenance task analysis and applicable access/egress requirements.

reviews.statement: Enclosure, cable gland, conduit/tubing entry와 sealing은 현장 물·먼지·부식·온도·진동 조건 및 승인된 보호등급/인증 조건을 훼손하지 않도록 설치한다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 60079-14:2024, Explosive atmospheres—Electrical installation design and installation
sources_checked.supports: Requires installation of Ex equipment according to applicable equipment protection and installation conditions.
sources_checked.gap: Applies to Ex installations and does not verify a universal enclosure ingress-protection/gland installation method for all environmental conditions.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Protection class, gland, sealing and corrosion requirements vary by certification, enclosure, cable and environment; exact assembly constraints are product-specific.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Verify the selected enclosure/gland certificate and manufacturer's installation instructions against area classification and environmental specification.

reviews.statement: 계장 cable은 tray·conduit·support의 허용경로를 따르고 날카로운 모서리, 과도한 인장, 압착, 열원, 침수 가능부와 기계적 손상을 피하도록 배치한다.

sources_checked.citation: OSHA 29 CFR 1926.405, Wiring methods, components and equipment for general use
sources_checked.supports: Includes wiring-method requirements and strain-relief provisions for covered flexible cords/cables.
sources_checked.gap: The cited construction rule is U.S.- and cable-type-specific and does not validate this full instrumentation-cable routing checklist for every plant.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Mechanical routing criteria depend on cable construction, tray system, environment and jurisdiction; the Anchor gives no applicable cable standard or route design.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Check cable datasheets, installation standard, tray/conduit design and project-specific pulling/temperature/flood exposure limits.

reviews.statement: 전력·motor/VFD 회로와 저레벨 계장·통신 회로의 분리거리와 교차방식은 승인된 wiring/EMC 설계와 프로젝트 기준에 따라 현장에서 유지하며 임의로 동일 tray에 혼재시키지 않는다.

sources_checked.citation: IEC 61000-5-2:1997, Electromagnetic compatibility—Earthing and cabling
sources_checked.supports: Provides guidance on earthing and cabling for EMC, including installation practices.
sources_checked.gap: Does not support one universal separation distance or an unconditional prohibition on shared trays for every installation.

reviews.unresolved_reason: Cable segregation is layout-, cable-, frequency-, bonding- and immunity-dependent; the correct distances and exceptions require the approved EMC design.
reviews.next_evidence_needed: Cite the applicable EMC/cable-routing design standard and verify the actual tray separation, crossing and bonding details.
